# Narrative @ Stage 11 — Abstract Emerge

> developed 2026-07-24.

## Crosswalk (from unified ladder)

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| IST Stage# | 11 |
| Canonical name | Abstract Emerge |
| Altitude | `orange` (Worldcentric emerging) |
| MHC Order | 10 (Abstract) |
| Kegan | 3→4 |
| Identity band | Worldcentric emerging |

## Expression on this line

Narrative capacity at Order 10 is narrative mastery: expert-level plot depth that operates
beyond conscious rule-following, producing storytelling that transcends inherited tradition.
The master storyteller who can improvise within the plot canon, innovate beyond it, and
teach others to do the same.

The key advance over Stage 10 is that narrative capacity is now *abstract* — it can be
reasoned about as a general phenomenon (what makes narrative mastery possible? what enables
plot innovation?) rather than just experienced in specific contexts.

## Integrity markers (healthy inclusion)

- **UL:** the felt fluency of expert storytelling — the master who works beyond conscious
  rule-following.
- **UR:** the capacity to innovate within and beyond inherited tradition, producing genuinely
  new narrative expressions.
- **LL:** a narrative culture that values mastery and innovation.
- **LR:** the institutional structures (writing workshops, narrative theory programs) that
  support narrative mastery.

## Pathology markers (Agape / Eros)

- **Dark addiction:** mastery as ego — the master storyteller who becomes identified with their
  expertise.
- **Dark allergy:** mastery absence — the individual who cannot develop expert-level plot
  depth.
- **Golden addiction:** claiming to have achieved formal narrative modeling (Stage 12) while
  actually just demonstrating expert narrative experience.
- **Golden allergy:** refusing to engage with narrative mastery because it seems "elitist."

## Diagnostic cues (Gross / Ground R&D)

- **Expert-level plot depth:** the individual demonstrates mastery that operates beyond
  conscious rule-following.
- **Narrative innovation:** the individual produces genuinely new work that transcends
  inherited tradition.
- **Teaching capacity:** the master can transmit their narrative expertise to others.

## Sources, joints, open questions

**Sources:** Eco, *The Role of the Reader* (expert narrative competence); Bakhtin,
*Problems of Dostoevsky's Poetics* (polyphonic narrative mastery).
**Open joints:** How does narrative mastery shade into formal narrative modeling (Stage 12)?
**Research debt:** pairs with `10-concrete-peak` (complex narrative integration) and
`12-formal-landmark` (formal narrative modeling).
